profile.visual_direction: expressive, colorful, approachable merchandising with a clear focal point, energetic accents, and a theme derived from the source
profile.typography_direction: bold rounded display type paired with a clean readable sans; use color blocks and badges for scanning, never clutter or unreadable microcopy
profile.mockup_direction: bright lifestyle, device, or flat-lay scenes with playful but believable props selected from the product category

generation_provenance.art_direction_summary: A joyful, colorful gallery for Daisy Flow Digital: saturated amethyst, lilac, teal and butter yellow accents, playful but tidy flat-lays, bright device mockups, and source-faithful planner pages presented as an approachable digital download.

concept_board.hero: A bright tablet hero on a lavender-and-teal desk, framed by playful stationery shapes and a confident color-pop palette.
concept_board.palette: Amethyst purple, lilac, teal, bright cyan, butter yellow, coral accents, white and deep plum.
concept_board.mockup: Colorful tablet, paper and device mockups generated with completely blank displays; exact PDF pages are inserted locally into those displays.
concept_board.gallery_rhythm: Hero, format collage, toolkit, monthly, daily, wellness, weekly, navigation, extras, and thank-you; use varied bright arrangements, cropped device views, and playful prop clusters without duplicating Temply scenes.
